anna (sec-eng): Heads up — we’re seeing IDP heartbeat mismatches for a subset of tenants and SCIM provisioning is lagging. RBAC roles look stale for a few orgs. Not sure if it’s network or KMS related. pinging infra and SRE.

josh (infra): looking. any recent config changes to the idp-proxy or heartbeat TTL?

anna (sec-eng): not on our side; last change was 2 days ago. Error surfaced after a midnight rollout window. Symptoms: SCIM POSTs succeed but deprovision flows hang and audit log shows missing KMS_encrypt events for role updates.

maria (sre): can you paste the root error from the app logs?

anna (sec-eng): sure — snippet from provisioner logs:

```
2026-02-10T00:12:03Z provisioner[pid=231]: WARN failed to apply role update for user=alice@example.com tenant=acme-corp err=KMS:encrypt error="invalid key alias"
2026-02-10T00:12:03Z provisioner[pid=231]: DEBUG scim/post -> 200 accepted, queued deprov action id=ff12
2026-02-10T00:12:05Z provisioner[pid=231]: ERROR idp-heartbeat mismatch: last_seen=2026-02-09T23:55:01Z expected_interval=60s
```

josh (infra): that invalid key alias rings a bell — we rotated the KMS alias last night but the private deployment agents weren't fully rolled. Ops-bot, do we have KMS rotation rollout status?

ops-bot: KMS rotation job #rot-20260209 completed in regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1; pending: ap-southeast-1 (2/5 hosts still on old alias). Notifying owners. :exclamation:

maria (sre): ap-southeast hosts coincide with the tenants reporting issues. So IDP heartbeat mismatch might be a side-effect of failed deprovision tasks queuing up. Need to confirm whether the provisioner retries are blocking heartbeats.

anna (sec-eng): also seeing missing audit events in our central audit index. securitybot, did any alert fire for missing KMS_encrypt entries?

securitybot: Alert: "auditlog.kms_encrypt.rate_drop" fired for service=provisioner at 2026-02-10T00:14:00Z. Count dropped from ~120/min to 3/min. Pager not triggered (info).

josh (infra): plan of action: 1) collect provisioner logs + idp-proxy healthcheck on affected hosts; 2) pull KMS key alias mapping from kms-config; 3) check agent versions on ap-southeast hosts; 4) collect audit index query for missing encrypt entries.

maria (sre): commands to run (on affected host):
```
# check idp heartbeat
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9250/health | jq .idp_heartbeat
# tail provisioner logs
sudo journalctl -u provisioner -o short-precise --since "2026-02-10 00:00" | tail -n 200
# confirm kms alias used by agent
sudo cat /etc/kms-config/alias || echo "missing"
```

anna (sec-eng): I collected one host output earlier, alias file shows `alias/redwood/provisioner/v2` but KMS rotation intended `alias/redwood/provisioner/v3`. Also found this in the agent env: `REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID=` (empty) — looks like rollout didn't inject secret.

josh (infra): ok that's the smoking gun. The bootstrap job that replaces alias references in `/etc/kms-config` failed on two ap-southeast hosts. I’ll run remediation to swap alias and restart service.

maria (sre): while you remediate, attach a short timeline and evidence bundle for security review. We need: provisioner logs, idp-proxy health output, kms-config file, and the audit query that shows missing encrypt events. Zip and upload to /shared/sec-incidents/1809999999/ — make sure to scrub PII.

anna (sec-eng): collecting now. note: for evidence, include a grep for "KMS:encrypt" and the correlation-id from the scim POST headers — that helps link audit entries.

josh (infra): remediation done on host ap-southeast-1b — swapped alias->v3, restarted provisioner, observed catching up: provisioner started emitting KMS:encrypt metrics again.

ops-bot: deployment note: host ap-southeast-1c still pending, owner @infra-oncall-asia notified.

maria (sre): monitoring: audit encrypt rate back to baseline within 90s, deprov queue drained for affected tenants. RBAC roles reconciled.

anna (sec-eng): next steps for post-mortem: - root cause: incomplete KMS alias rollout + missing env injection - mitigation: add rollout pre-check that verifies /etc/kms-config alias and env presence; block rollout completion until all hosts report. - short-term: force sync and backfill audit events for any missed role updates.

josh (infra): I’ll open a runbook PR with the pre-check and a playbook to rotate aliases safely. Assigning @josh (infra) to own runbook, @maria (sre) to own monitoring rules, @anna (sec-eng) to own audit backfill.

anna (sec-eng): thanks — uploading evidence bundle now and will kick off backfill job after security reviews. :thumbsup:

maria (sre): if anything regresses, re-open thread and tag oncall. Good catch everyone.

securitybot: Incident log appended: incident_id=INC-20260210-7621 severity=medium status=resolved
